findings.title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler cannot be instantiated: abstract methods not implemented
findings.body: MetricAlertDetectorHandler now subclasses StatefulDetectorHandler with only `pass` as its body. StatefulDetectorHandler (and its parent DetectorHandler) declare several abc.abstractmethod members that are not implemented here: the `counter_names` property, `get_dedupe_value`, `get_group_key_values`, and the newly-added `build_occurrence_and_event_data`. Because both DetectorHandler and StatefulDetectorHandler inherit from abc.ABC, Python will raise `TypeError: Can't instantiate abstract class MetricAlertDetectorHandler with abstract methods ...` the moment anything tries to construct this handler (e.g. `Detector.detector_handler` property calling `group_type.detector_handler(self)`). Previously this class subclassed the non-abstract-in-practice DetectorHandler with a concrete (if stub) `evaluate` method, so it could be instantiated; this change silently breaks that. Any processing path that reaches a detector of type `metric_alert_fire` will now crash.

findings.title: Stale docstring still describes evaluate() as returning a list
findings.body: The docstring for StatefulDetectorHandler.evaluate() still says "Evaluates a given data packet and returns a list of `DetectorEvaluationResult`", but the method (and the whole point of this PR) now returns a `dict[DetectorGroupKey, DetectorEvaluationResult]`. The stale wording is misleading to future readers/maintainers about the actual contract.

findings.title: No test exercises MetricAlertDetectorHandler after it was changed to subclass StatefulDetectorHandler
findings.body: The PR changes `MetricAlertDetectorHandler` in src/sentry/incidents/grouptype.py to subclass the abstract `StatefulDetectorHandler` with an empty body, which makes the class impossible to instantiate (missing implementations for `counter_names`, `get_dedupe_value`, `get_group_key_values`, `build_occurrence_and_event_data`). No test in this PR (or elsewhere in the diff) attempts to construct or evaluate a detector of type `metric_alert_fire`, so this regression is not caught by the test suite. A simple test instantiating `Detector.detector_handler` for this grouptype would have caught the abstract-class instantiation failure before merge.
